User.title: User
User.description: Represents a registered user profile in the system.

uid.description: The unique Firebase Authentication UID of the user.

role.description: The user's role in the application.

hasSetCustomName.description: Indicates if the user has completed their onboarding profile setup.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the profile was created.

Room.title: Room
Room.description: Represents a synchronized watch party room where users can watch videos together and chat in real-time.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Room entity.

videoUrl.description: The URL of the video being watched in the room. This can be a YouTube URL or a direct link to an .mp4 file.

hostName.description: The display name of the user who created and is currently hosting the room. This user has control over video playback.

roomName.description: An optional user-defined name for the watch party room.

password.description: An optional password required for users to join the room. This adds a layer of privacy to the room.

guests.description: A list of display names of users currently participating in the room, excluding the host.

allTimeMembers.description: A permanent record of all users who ever joined this room.

status.description: The current lifecycle status of the room (active, ended).

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the room was created.

endedAt.description: The timestamp when the room was ended by the host.

videoStateStatus.description: The current playback status of the video in the room (e.g., 'playing', 'paused', 'stopped'). Controlled by the host.

videoStateTimestamp.description: The current playback position of the video in seconds, synchronized across all participants.

videoStateUpdatedAt.description: The timestamp when the video state (status or timestamp) was last updated by the host. Used for synchronization logic.

isScheduled.description: Indicates if this room is scheduled for a future time.

startTime.description: The scheduled start time for the watch party.

notifyList.description: List of user UIDs who wish to be notified when this session starts.

Message.title: Message
Message.description: Represents a single chat message sent by a user within a specific watch party room.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Message entity.

roomId.description: Reference to the Room where this message was sent. (Relationship: Room 1:N Message)

senderName.description: The display name of the user who sent the message.

text.description: The content of the chat message.

timestamp.description: The timestamp when the message was sent, used for ordering messages.

replyTo.description: Reference to another message being replied to.

maintenanceMessage.description: Custom message to display during maintenance.

definition.description: Stores user profile and account information.
Represents a synchronized watch party room. This document contains the video state, current host (by UID), and a map of all participant UIDs with their roles (host/guest) for authorization.

params.name: roomId
params.description: The unique identifier for the watch party room.

definition.description: Represents a single chat message within a specific watch party room. Each message includes the sender's UID ('senderId') for authentication.

params.name: roomId
params.description: The unique identifier of the parent room to which this message belongs.

params.name: messageId
params.description: The unique identifier for the chat message.

definition.description: Global system settings, including maintenance mode status.

firestore.reasoning: The structure prioritizes Authorization Independence and real-time synchronization. User profiles are segregated in a top-level collection, while rooms and their associated messages maintain local authorization context for efficient security rules evaluation.
